rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly on design: ~ subject + condition with control as reference, an LRT against ~ subject as the omnibus test, and all three pairwise contrasts pulled from one fit with ashr shrinkage and BH, explicitly rejecting subset refits and unpaired models. QC is thorough (library sizes, PCA coloured by condition/subject before and after subject-mean removal, correlation heatmap, label-swap check, explicit no-drop policy), and filtering uses filterByExpr on the design. Normalization is only implicit via DESeqDataSet on raw counts; size factors are never named, though the plan does forbid feeding batch-corrected values into the model. The |LFC|>0.5 count is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold, and enrichment names collections and size windows but gives no collection version and package versions are not required in the report.
